title: Microwave or radiofrequency thermoablation for canine hepatocellular carcinoma
status: Ongoing European oncology clinical trial — listed by Oncowaf
notes: Microwave or radiofrequency thermoablation for primary hepatocellular carcinoma or limited hepatic metastases; public criteria specify 1–6 cm lesions, normal hepatic function, no coagulopathy and ability to undergo anesthesia.

title: Local microwave treatment for canine chemodectoma
status: Ongoing European oncology clinical trial — listed by Oncowaf
notes: Local microwave treatment for non-metastatic chemodectoma, including tumors increasing in size under other treatments.

title: Photodynamic therapy for canine mammary tumors
status: Ongoing European oncology clinical trial — listed by Oncowaf
funding: Confirm costs with University of Évora.
notes: Photodynamic anticancer treatment study for female dogs with mammary tumors; Oncowaf lists age up to 12 years and excludes metastatic disease and serious comorbidity.

title: Autologous hydroxyapatite-based cancer vaccine for canine mucosal melanoma
center: AniCura I Portoni Rossi / University of Teramo
status: Ongoing European oncology clinical trial — listed by Oncowaf
contacts: Riccardo Finotello — riccardo.finotello@anicura.it; Valentina Rinaldi — vrinaldi@unite.it
funding: Confirm study-covered and owner-paid costs with the investigators.
notes: Autologous hydroxyapatite-based cancer vaccine study for mucosal melanoma. The primary tumor must still be available for vaccine preparation; previously excised/formalin-fixed-only tumors are not eligible.
